caption: The drawing depicts two human figures positioned centrally against a brown background that is framed and interspersed with floral designs featuring large pink and red flowers, green leaves, and smaller blue flowers. The figure on the left is a person wearing a green hat and green clothing, holding a wind instrument to their mouth as if playing it. To the right and slightly in front, there is a second person wearing a long pink headscarf or bonnet, a pale blue dress with pinkish-red accents, and brown shoes. This figure appears to be holding or interacting with a small object or animal on the ground. The flowers and foliage form a decorative border along the left, right, and top edges of the central brown section, while sparse green grass grows along the bottom. The colors used are predominantly shades of brown, pink, red, green, blue, and white. The drawing is signed "Paul Hibb" in the lower left outside the illustrated area.
title: Cotton Cloth
